_comment: The SIF Insight YouTube catalogue. `id` is the YouTube video id; `title` is the video's own title, verbatim. `displayTitle`, where present, is the neutral title the site prints instead: a verbatim title that makes a return or outcome claim, or uses words the compliance copy bans, is quoted nowhere on the site. `durationSec` and `publishedAt` stay null until read from YouTube itself — never estimated. `featuredOrder` 1-4 picks the home-page videos (null = library only); the final pick is the client's. `excluded` records ids that must NEVER be shown, with the reason, so a copy-paste from the old site cannot bring one back.
